generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of Robotics development laboratory (机器人研发室). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Show a clean robotics development laboratory in a wide vertical three-quarter composition. Anchor a single powered-down industrial robotic arm behind a waist-high safety bench, with the light curtain posts visible on both sides but not glowing excessively. Across the foreground bench, separate the prototype board, distance sensor, servo motor, wire harness and printed chassis so each has a readable silhouette. Put the soldering station at the far left with its iron safely docked, the teach pendant hanging centrally, and the digital caliper at lower right. Two engineers may observe from behind the barrier. Use cool industrial daylight with one warm bench lamp. No sparks, exposed mains wiring, readable code, brand marks, humanoid robots, duplicate circuit boards or science-fiction holograms.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: industrial robotic arm, circuit prototype board, distance sensor module, robotics servo motor, temperature-controlled soldering station, robotics wire harness, 3D-printed robot chassis, robot safety light curtain, robot teach pendant, digital caliper gauge.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
